rules.reopening_condition: a new product LiveView route, module, session, socket, or render is admitted
a new product LiveComponent is admitted
new product behavior depends on a LiveView event, stream, or hook
a new LiveVue bridge or Vue product source is admitted
a new SaladUI consumer is admitted
dashboard exposure widens beyond the exact development-only exception
an inline executable script enters HEEx
a remote or CDN product asset is loaded
product code bypasses a reviewed projection or command contract
product code accesses TripleStore or graph write primitives directly
caller input selects a graph grant, graph target, or authoritative revision
browser state creates authority, assurance, delegation, or revisions
a GET route performs a semantic effect
web code invokes runtime effects outside the governed command gateway
a target surface omits its authority, security, receipt, DOM, fallback, or availability declaration
